data.title: 缪尔赛思 · 灯火映在玻璃上
data.description: 她数着窗外的灯火，忽然转身靠近，问你有没有发现玻璃里也映着两个人的影子。
data.action: 靠窗转身，双手搭在窗沿看向镜头
data.lighting: 城市灯火与柔和室内光
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: Standing before a panoramic floor-to-ceiling high-rise window overlooking a neon-drenched metropolis at night, Muelsyse turns playfully back toward the viewer, pointing to their twin reflections transparently mirrored on the dark glass. Warm amber room lighting softly illuminates her silhouette and aqua hair tips, contrasting against the endless galaxy of city lights outside.
